originalEntry.title: Voxel soccer goal animation in Three.js
originalEntry.author: AGI_FromWalmart
originalEntry.description: A short voxel-style Three.js animation in one HTML file: a blocky player dribbles past two defenders and scores, followed by celebration particles.
originalEntry.description_zh: 单个 HTML 文件里的体素风 Three.js 动画：方块球员连过两名后卫破门，随后飘起庆祝粒子。
originalEntry.prompt: Create a single HTML file with Three.js (CDN) for a simple voxel-style soccer animation. A blocky player dribbles past 2 defenders and scores a spectacular goal with celebration particles. Colorful stadium look. Output ONLY the full HTML code.
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 用 Three.js（CDN）写一个单 HTML 文件，做一段简单的体素风足球动画。一个方块小人带球过掉 2 名后卫，打进一记精彩进球，并伴有庆祝粒子。球场要色彩丰富。只输出完整的 HTML 代码。
